tasks.short: Take and record dental histories and vital signs

steps.what: Take medical and dental histories and measure vital signs
Record histories and vital signs in the dental record
Check history meaning, measurements and patient identity before saving

tasks.design: Configure a direct-entry history form in the dental record {OTHER}, avoiding duplicate transcription where it exists. The assistant still interviews and measures, enters or confirms every current field, and checks the resulting record before saving; no diagnosis or automatic inference is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: History answers and measurements may be written temporarily and then re-entered into a separate screen.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms and explicit unchanged-or-updated confirmation can reduce duplicate entry while preserving current confirmation.
tasks.still_hard: Clarifying medication details, uncertain history and inconsistent measurements without assuming a blank means no risk.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant can notice uncertainty, repeat a measurement and involve the dentist.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate entry when present; no change to interview time, measurement time or clinical scope.

reach.task: Check that a history template distinguishes absent, unknown and unconfirmed facts

evidence.claim: Native structured forms and current confirmation can reduce duplicate history transcription; the proposed allocation is model knowledge, not a dental trial result.
The Dutch general-practice ambient-scribe study found reduced documentation time without a change in total consultation time; it does not demonstrate dental interview savings.
Health data requires the applicable special-category processing basis and professional secrecy safeguards.

assumptions: Boundary is history taking, measurements and saving this record; treatment decisions and general record maintenance are separate.

Assistant produces history and observations in s1 and captures patient identifier, encounter date, condition answers, allergy substance and reaction, medication details as known, measured value, unit, measurement time and unknown flags in s2. All capture time remains in s1 and the retained 10 hours of s2.

Old values are never treated as current automatically. Assistant confirms them with the patient; absent, unknown and declined answers remain distinct. Missing fields use manual entry, not inferred defaults.
Try native dental-record form configuration before custom code. Savings exist only where duplicate transcription is observed; existing electronic entry earns none.
Check role permissions, data access and national employee consultation requirements during rollout.
unknowns: Whether temporary notes are currently retyped
Local assistant scope and access rights
research_questions: Does direct entry remove duplication without reducing clarification or increasing unchecked carry-forward errors?

already_counted.description: Current field capture and manual exceptions
Meaning, identity and measurement review before save

incremental.description: Maintain form fields, access checks and carry-forward exception review

approvals.approved_version: Exact patient and encounter record with history answers, uncertainty flags, measured values, units and times; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100, R=60+10+15=85; gross 15 minus 2 upkeep gives central net 13. High requires duplicate transcription within the 25-hour entry step. Low assumes just 2 hours removed in an already mostly direct-entry practice, consumed by upkeep. Patient and measurement time remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Schedule visits, bill, receive payment and maintain dental records

steps.what: Schedule appointments with patients using available dental slots
Verify dental service facts, patient details and insurance fields
Prepare bills and complete insurance forms from verified entries
Check and release bills and authorised insurance forms
Receive payment and resolve patient payment questions
Maintain appointment, billing, insurance and receipt records

tasks.design: Configure appointment-type filters, billing templates and linked records in the dental practice {OTHER}. Verified service and insurance fields populate drafts; the assistant checks and releases each bill or form and retains patient payment conversations and exceptions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Separate screens or forms require repeated entry of the same verified administrative facts.
tasks.enabler_now: Native field reuse, tariff arithmetic and linked records can reduce repetition without generating treatment codes from narrative.
tasks.still_hard: Disputed treatment codes, uncertain coverage and patient affordability questions require clarification.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant can explain a charge, recognise uncertainty and obtain a dentist's correction before release.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated administrative entry; no new authority to choose treatment, promise coverage or waive charges.

reach.task: Investigate a billing-field mismatch against the authorised source record
reach.learn: Tariff versions, insurer fields and correction routes

evidence.claim: Native practice administration can reuse verified fields for bills, forms and linked records; arithmetic and template filling need no language model. Savings here are an unmeasured scenario.
Health information used in administration remains subject to special-category data safeguards.

assumptions: Boundary is appointment and payment administration, not clinical history taking or treatment coding decisions.

Assistant captures request, appointment type and agreed time in retained s1. Existing authorised scheduler settings supply duration and allowed slots; changes require the existing clinical scheduling owner and are covered by upkeep, not free new labour.

In s2 the assistant checks and enters patient identifier, payer, service date, dentist-authorised service code, quantity, tariff version, insurance identifier, required form fields and exception status. Full 20 hours include source verification and field capture. Dentist authorisation is an existing prerequisite, never generated or reclassified by this design.
Draft generation in s3 uses only s2 entries. Unknown coverage, missing authorisation or mismatched codes stop normal release and return to manual clarification within retained time.
In s5 assistant records amount, method, time and bill reference; physical handling and patient explanation retain all time. Native receipt and record links reduce only repeated filing in s6.
Test native practice-system configuration first; existing tariff calculation and record links earn no new saving. Retain manual workflow if native reuse is absent.
Roll-up must not add this administration saving to a separate history-record saving for the same entry.
unknowns: Current duplicate entry and available native links
National insurer formats and role release permissions
Who maintains appointment types and tariff versions
research_questions: Which fields are genuinely retyped today, and do configured links preserve corrections, patient identity and tariff dates?

already_counted.description: Verify and capture all bill/form source fields
Meaning and authorisation check before release

incremental.description: Maintain field mappings, template and tariff-version checks and access exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact bill and insurance form including patient, payer, service date, authorised codes, quantities, tariff version, totals and recipient; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100; R=16+20+10+15+10+4=75. Gross 25 less 3 upkeep yields central net 22. High requires repeated entry in scheduling, drafting and filing; low assumes existing native links leave only 3 hours removable, consumed by upkeep. Source checks, release and payment conversation retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep patient interaction and clinical-source checks while reducing duplicate history and administrative entry where it actually exists.
reach: Help medical assistants trace source-field mismatches and improve checked templates
role.ambitious_version: A dental assistant who can keep records and administration consistent without extending clinical authority.
